description: Narrow two-way fixed-effects difference-in-differences (TWFE DiD) estimator. Causal interpretation rests on parallel trends, no anticipation, and treatment-effect homogeneity / clean two-group adoption. It is NOT a generally robust estimator for staggered adoption with heterogeneous treatment effects (Goodman-Bacon bias). For heterogeneous staggered designs, the study design must route to economics.causal.did.staggered (group-time ATT), never silently to TWFE. TWFE is used here only as an allowed narrow specification/reference calculation or in genuinely homogeneous/clean-adoption designs.

references.name: Goodman-Bacon 2021 — difference-in-differences with variation in treatment timing (TWFE decomposition / bias)
Callaway & Sant'Anna 2021 — difference-in-differences with multiple time periods (modern staggered alternative)
Sun & Abraham 2021 — estimating dynamic treatment effects in event studies with heterogeneous treatment effects (event-study alternative)

methodology.note: TWFE DiD is a narrow estimator. It is acceptable as (a) an allowed reference/naive calculation or (b) the estimator for a genuinely two-group / homogeneous-adoption design that satisfies parallel trends and no anticipation. It is NOT acceptable as a generally robust replacement for a modern staggered-group-time ATT estimator. The causality rests on design assumptions that are human/Director scientific judgments, not machine-verified facts. This contract must not present ordinary TWFE as a robust solution for staggered adoption with heterogeneous treatment effects.

verification.evidence: Declared experimental in registry. NOT benchmarked/verified in this environment: pyfixest is not installed in any detected Python runtime (p7-venv 3.14.3, system 3.14, system 3.9). No genuine real-data TWFE DiD benchmark was produced. Remains experimental, NOT tested, NOT verified.

Declared reference. reghdfe is available in the environment (StataNow19) and can estimate TWFE, but no genuine real-data DiD benchmark was produced because no canonical real DiD dataset is obtainable in this environment (mpdta / did package unavailable, CRAN unreachable). No fabricated result. Remains reference, NOT tested, NOT verified.
